svg.title: A cheerful anomaly badge hovers while clinic staff carry paper records.
svg.desc: Staff move organised stacks of forms and medicine counts along the corridor. Cecil presents a bright congratulatory badge over the locked scheduler, and Ananya suggests using it as a tray.
